scenes.title: Signed journey 1
actions: Start at 3 on the signed number line; label the starting balance before moving.
Read the first operation + (-5): its signed movement is -5. Draw the direction from the starting tick before landing.
+ (-5) means move 5 ticks left from 3; arrive at -2. Keep the earlier jump visible.
Finish at -2. Recalculate the original operations from 3 to verify every signed change.
scenes.memo: The jumps are 3 → -2. The signed result is -2; substitute the same changes into the original expression.
scenes.misconception: Subtraction reverses the sign of the next movement; the prior path must remain visible.
